scope.types: Removed duplicated snapshot, disk and inspection-policy interfaces; import type reuses the server contract without a runtime server dependency.
scope.owner: The report component remounts for a different user, role, work domain or organization connection. Cleanup aborts all owned requests and rejects subsequent old callbacks.
scope.reads: Report and sensor queries have independent request lanes. Each newer read invalidates the previous response, including late parse completion and errors.
scope.mutations: Allow/scan and decline share one operation path and busy state. The request map locks synchronously against duplicate gestures; mutations invalidate pending report reads and suppress new reads until finished.
scope.truth: Use existing apiJson authentication and HTTP/business-result checks; failed or contradictory authorization cannot advance to scanning, and missing scan results cannot show success.
scope.sensors: Permission/native capability refresh now uses the same loader for mount, permission changes and visible document events; late sensor results cannot overwrite newer state.
scope.partialFailure: Knowledge storage failure is shown as unverified without discarding unrelated system data. Latest snapshot and history remain separate authoritative sources.

testsCovered: Repeated clicks and language changes during scanning
Account switch during authorization, with no stale follow-up scan
Newer report survives a late previous read
Explicit decline and grant request bodies
Rejected authorization and empty scan results
Visible document permission refresh, stale sensors, listener cleanup, and isolated knowledge failure
limitations: Mounted component tests simulate API/native permission data; this is not native desktop acceptance.
Abort cancels client requests and subsequent UI work, not a write already accepted by the server.
Sensor snapshot/native IPC helpers cannot cancel their underlying reads; late results are ignored.
